author: Matt Chittum - Virginia Tech
title: Keto diet could improve response to exercise in people with high blood sugar
description: Feeding mice with hyperglycemia a high-fat, low-carbohydrate diet lowered their blood sugar and improved their bodies’ response to exercise.
content:
A new study finds that feeding mice with hyperglycemia a high-fat, low-carbohydrate diet lowered their blood sugar and improved their bodies’ response to exercise.
